regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and ESI/CCDC footnote
regions.finding: Confirmed the true article title 'Palladium(0)-catalyzed synthesis of cyclic glucosides' and aggregate claims. The page states ESI availability, but workspace source mapping leaves SI association unestablished, so no SI facts were imported. CCDC 987494 is crystallographic data, not an inferred SI association.
Phlorizin, sergliflozin, dapagliflozin, and canagliflozin are contextual SGLT2-inhibitor structures, not current-paper reaction experiments.
Generic design of a Pd-catalyzed cyclic-glucoside class with Nu/Ar variables; classified as a general scheme without an experiment-specific yield.
The initial PhI/Pd2(dba)3·CHCl3/TFP/K2CO3 solvent and temperature observations map to the seven Table 1 rows on page 2. They were linked cross-page rather than duplicated.

Two arrows were distinguished: 3a undergoes MeONa/MeOH deacetylation and Amberlite treatment to 4a in 97%, matching Table 3 entry 1; 4a then undergoes BzCl/pyridine benzoylation from 0 °C to room temperature over the reported 12 h to give 5 in 87%. The ramp/hold allocation is not specified.
The concentration and 2a-equivalent observations begin the eleven Table 2 optimization rows printed on page 2 and do not create narrative duplicates.

unresolved: SI is stated to exist but no file association is established.
The 4a-to-5 diagram does not state scale, ramp duration, workup, purification, product mass, or yield basis.
Complex glucoside structures remain label-only and machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 reaction header, rows 1–7, and footnotes
regions.finding: Seven independent solvent/temperature experiments were retained with common 1 concentration (0.067 M), 2a 2 equiv, Pd catalyst 2.5 mol%, TFP 10 mol%, K2CO3 4 equiv, row solvent/temperature/time, crude-1H-NMR yields, mesitylene basis, and entry-2 recovery of 1 (83%) kept separate from its 0% product yield.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 reaction header, rows 1–11, and footnotes
regions.finding: Eleven separate optimization records retain 0.1 mmol scale, row-specific 2a equivalents, DMF or DMF/H2O ratios, concentration, time, NMR yield, 100 °C, Pd/ligand/K2CO3 loadings, mesitylene basis, and the entry-11 replacement of TFP by 10 mol% PPh3.
ORTEP of compound 5 is crystallographic characterization of the page-1 benzoylation product and not another reaction experiment.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Table 3 reaction drawing, rows 1–12, and footnotes
regions.finding: Twelve coupling-cyclization experiments and eleven subsequent deacetylation experiments were separated by arrow. Entry 7 is an independent 4 mmol repeat of 1+2f giving 3f in 34% and has a dash for 4, so no deacetylation record was invented. All isolated yields, scales, catalyst/reagent loadings, N2, 100 °C/5 h, and deacetylation stages were retained.

regions.region: page 2 scope narrative adjacent to Table 3
regions.finding: The narrative says the optimized medium is DMA, while the Table 3 drawing/footnote and page-3 procedure specify DMF/H2O = 80/1. Both statements and their evidence are preserved; the table/procedure medium populates the scope records and the discrepancy remains unresolved.

unresolved: DMA in the narrative conflicts with DMF/H2O = 80/1 in the Table 3 drawing/footnote and exact procedure.
The compact cyclic vinyl iodide 2k/product 3k structures remain source labels with null SMILES.
Table 3 does not report workups, purifications, masses, or absolute deacetylation quantities for most rows.

regions.finding: Conclusion restates the reported reaction class and ongoing biological work; it adds no independent experiment or SGLT2 inhibition result.

regions.region: page 3 left-column Typical Procedure I reaction drawing and paragraph
regions.finding: The exact 1 mmol preparation of 3a matches Table 3 entry 1 and was merged into that record, adding vessel, sequential charging, nitrogen, exact masses/amounts, DMF/H2O 80/1 (40 mL), 100 °C/5 h, TLC, workup, chromatography, 197.4 mg, and 36% isolated yield.

Wanli Zhang is thanked for reproducing preparations of 3c, 4c, 3h, and 4h. The statement is linked to the corresponding Table 3 records as provenance but supplies no independent conditions or outcome, so no duplicate runs were created.
Bibliography and prior-literature context only; cited external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: The main article gives a full detailed procedure only for 3a; operational details for other scope/deacetylation rows remain missing.
Reproduction acknowledgements do not define separable runs.

regions.finding: Synthesis of allenyl beta-D-glucoside 1 is attributed to an external Synthesis 2014 paper; no current-paper quantities or operation are restated, so it was not converted into a current experiment.

Crystal data and CCDC 987494 characterize compound 5 from the page-1 benzoylation. This is not another preparation, does not verify a machine structure encoding, and is not treated as an associated SI file.

regions.region: page 4 reference 9 and remaining blank area
regions.finding: The deacetylation citation and publisher furniture provide prior-literature context only; no new current-paper arrow, procedure, yield, or failure result is present.

unresolved: CCDC deposition is crystallographic characterization rather than an SI association.
The cited preparation of 1 and deacetylation literature were not expanded beyond facts explicitly reported in this article.
No new reaction operation occurs on page 4.
